sneak_attack_1d6.name: Sneak Attack
sneak_attack_1d6.description: Deal extra precision damage (+1d6 at 1st level, increasing by +1d6 every two rogue levels) when target is flanked or denied DEX bonus to AC.

trapfinding.name: Trapfinding
trapfinding.description: Use the Search skill to locate traps with DC > 20 and Disable Device to disarm magic traps.

evasion.name: Evasion
evasion.description: Take no damage instead of half damage on a successful Reflex saving throw.

uncanny_dodge.name: Uncanny Dodge
uncanny_dodge.description: Retain Dexterity bonus to AC even if caught flat-footed or struck by an invisible attacker.

rogue_special_ability_1.name: Rogue Special Ability
rogue_special_ability_1.description: Select from Crippling Strike (2 STR damage), Defensive Roll, Improved Evasion, Opportunist, Skill Mastery, or Slippery Mind.

acfSwaps.name: Penetrating Strike
acfSwaps.description: Replaces Trap Sense: whenever you flank a creature that is immune to extra damage from sneak attacks, you still deal extra damage equal to half your normal sneak attack dice.
